sources.snippet: Surprisingly, the resulted model PoolFormer consistently outperforms the DeiT and ResMLP as shown in (b), which well supports that MetaFormer is actually what we need to achieve competitive performance. RSB-ResNet in (b) means the results are from "ResNet Strikes Back" where ResNet is trained with improved training procedure for 300 epochs.

sources.title: Microsoft Foundry Models overview - Microsoft Foundry
sources.snippet: The model catalog in Foundry portal is the hub for discovering and using a wide range of models to build generative AI applications. The model catalog features thousands of models from providers like Azure OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral, Meta, Cohere, NVIDIA, and Hugging Face, including models that Microsoft trained.
